messages:
tara: Quick sync — Silverline marketplace + HWSI pairing goes live 10:00 PT. We need a compact partner-SEV lane that covers marketplace tiles, partner HW image flashes, and SI webhooks. Aim: single channel, deterministic hooks, and a 48h warm-standby.

noah: Agreed. Minimal flow: shared channel (#sl-silverline-launch-ops) -> partner/SI triage -> Redwood oncall -> partner eng. Add region-aware PD fallback and an explicit postmortem trigger.

ameer: I want the routing to be machine-friendly. Suggest a tiny JSON runbook we pin and infra can read: 
```
{"route":"alerts.silverline.*","channel":"#sl-silverline-launch-ops","pager_policy":"PD_SL_LAUNCH","escalation":[{"mins":0,"owner":"partner-sd"},{"mins":10,"owner":"redwood-oncall"},{"mins":30,"owner":"partner-eng"}]}
```

diane: Love the JSON idea. Also add a warm-standby rota: 1hr shifts for first 24h, then 2h checks until 48h. We'll pin a simple checklist: owner, surface (market/hw/si), region, customers impacted Y/N, rollback toggle id, bridge link.

tara: ops-bot — can you scaffold the channel, pin the runbook, and wire the webhook rules for alert.tag=="silverline.launch"? Also create a bridge template named silverline-launch-warroom.

ops-bot: action: /scaffold-channel sl-silverline-launch-ops --pins runbook.json,checklist.md --invite @tara,@noah,@ameer,@diane; /route alert.tag=="silverline.launch" -> #sl-silverline-launch-ops; /create-bridge-template silverline-launch-warroom --auto-status 30m

noah: For PD wiring: immediate notify channel + page PD after 8m if unresolved. If both hw and marketplace alerts fire, auto-create bridge and page PD for both surfaces. Also tag alerts with customer_impact boolean so CSMs know when to notify.

ameer: I'll add a tiny Slack workflow to capture incident metadata on first post: fields region,severity,customer_impact,owner; auto-pin the summary.

diane: Postmortem ownership rule: any Sev2+ within 72h -> partner_eng_lead + release_manager assigned. Prevents ownership confusion.

tara: I'll add a one-line ops blurb to the announcement: "Ops path: #sl-silverline-launch-ops (warm-watch 48h); see pinned runbook for routing and PD ids." We'll run a dry-run tonight to validate webhooks and PD policies.

noah: Dry-run good idea. Also, include a small rollback guard for the HW image with safe-image tag and rollback command snippet pinned.

ops-bot: note: dry-run available: /ops-bot dry-run sl-silverline-launch-ops -> validates webhooks, PD policies, bridge template

ameer: I'll draft the pinned JSON runbook + checklist and drop them before EOD. After dry-run, tara can publish the announcement with the ops link.

tara: Thanks team — will run dry-run and post results. :thumbsup:
